summary: Frontend-only mobile (390x800) verification of new rare rituals + Fates Witnessed page + StrictMode regression + winter flourish + contrast fix. All 3 new rituals (Ouija/DragonEye/TreasureChest) render, complete, unmount, and hand back to reveal card. Truncation @ 12 glyphs works (spelled 'ROUGE - RESTAUR…' for 'Rouge - Restaurant and Bar'). /rituals page correctly shows 3/15 progress with count badges (×1) for completed rituals and '? ? ?' + lock icon for the other 12. Home has fates-witnessed-link that navigates to /rituals. StrictMode doneRef fix verified: coffin/seance/shaker/wand/hack all unmount cleanly after ritual completion. Winter flourish mounts (data-flourish='winter') ~3s after deal and /flourish-winter.mp3 returns HTTP 200 (verified via curl; not fetched in-app when ff_muted=1 which is correct). Normal spin on light theme reveals result-card. Dark theme cuisine group headers are dark ink rgb(14,14,14) on white cards (contrast fix confirmed). No console errors, no 404s on any new asset (reaper-planchette.png, hoard-eye-closed.png, hoard-eye-open.png, hoard-chest-closed.png, hoard-chest-open.png all load). recordRitualSeen is called correctly at Home.jsx:412 the moment surpriseReveal is set, so localStorage ff_rituals_seen accumulates {key:{count,first}} across deals as designed.

ritual_results.ouija (NEW): cover mounts, prompt shown, single tap starts planchette, spelled accumulates R->RO->...->ROUGE - RESTAUR…, truncated at 12 glyphs w/ ellipsis, cover unmounts ~11s, reveal-card appears
ritual_results.eye (NEW): cover mounts w/ hoard-eye-closed.png + 'The dragon sleeps... tap to wake it' + 3 dots, 3 taps -> crossfade to hoard-eye-open.png + embers + dragon-eye-done text, cover unmounts, reveal-card appears
ritual_results.chest (NEW): cover mounts w/ hoard-chest-closed.png + 'Break the lock!' + 3 dots, 3 taps -> crossfade to hoard-chest-open.png + chest-coins fountain + chest-done text, cover unmounts, reveal-card appears
ritual_results.wand (regression): unmounts after single tap (JS synthetic click)

fates_witnessed_page.locked_cards: 12 locked cards showing '? ? ?' + realm hint (All realms / Fairy Gully / Cyberscape / Reaper / Dragon's Hoard / Steampunk / Tiki Lounge) + lock icon
fates_witnessed_page.fates-witnessed-link on home: present below Champions/Passport Wall, navigates to /rituals

winter_flourish.data-flourish=winter mounts: yes, ~3000ms after deal tap on theme=winter
winter_flourish.flourish-winter.mp3 HTTP status: 200 (verified via curl; file is 61,821 bytes, content-type audio/mpeg)
winter_flourish.note: MP3 not fetched by app when ff_muted=1 (expected — ThemeFlourish.jsx line 19 guards `new Audio` behind !ff_muted). This is not a bug.

contrast_verification.theme=dark cuisine-group headers: color rgb(14,14,14) on transparent-over-white card (high contrast) ✓
contrast_verification.cuisine pills / mode tabs: visually legible in screenshot (dark text on light-gray)

critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is now 1589 lines - still exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider extracting the rare-fate variant selection + surpriseReveal state + surpriseDone handler + recordRitualSeen call into a useRareFate hook.

All 12 ritual components share the same doneRef+timersRef+later()+useEffect cleanup pattern (now fixed). This is ripe for a shared useRitualLifecycle({onDone, doneDelayMs}) hook to DRY ~60 lines across 12 files.
OuijaBoard MAX_SPELLED=12 truncates mid-word ('ROUGE - RESTAUR…'). Consider trimming at word boundary or using ' — ' as a natural break so short-first-word names look complete.

recordRitualSeen(variant) is called on ritual START (Home.jsx:412), not on ritual COMPLETE. That means 'Fates Witnessed' will count rituals the user aborted (e.g., closed the tab mid-ritual). Consider moving it to onDone / surpriseDone if the design intent is 'saw the ritual conclude'.

ff_rare_force in localStorage is a dev/QA switch trusted without theme-pool validation. Fine, but leaving as-is could let non-dev users unlock arbitrary rituals via devtools — worth a one-line comment or guarding with a build flag.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new rituals and the /rituals collection page are working correctly. To exercise a ritual via automation, prefer a synthetic mouse-event via page.evaluate rather than page.click(force=True) — the framer-motion transform on the ritual overlay confuses Playwright's viewport hit-test on the first .click() call. See js_click() helper: dispatch mousedown+mouseup+click via el.dispatchEvent. recordRitualSeen fires on ritual START (line 412 Home.jsx), so any test that mounts the ritual cover already records +1 to ff_rituals_seen, regardless of whether the ritual completes. ff_muted=1 skips new Audio() so no /flourish-*.mp3 fetch will fire during automation — verify audio URLs via curl instead.
rca of the issue: n/a - no bugs found. Only minor code-quality notes above.
